verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a data-integration tool with public documentation, so the axis applies. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at docs.meltano.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The ordinary CLI reference docs are standard human-facing documentation and do not count as agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
